title: From the mutual lock to the rapidity staircase
title_zh: 从互指锁死到快度阶梯
summary: Alone, an observer that reads itself by x ↦ cos x swings across θ* ≈ 0.739 at every step; two observers that read each other approach θ* from one side, round after round. From θ*, equal steps on the outside angle ruler hit 90° on the second step, while equal steps in the rapidity η = ∫ sec θ dθ climb a staircase whose gap 1 − tanh η never closes. In the complex plane the same edge is the unit circle: ‖(s − 1)/s‖ = 1 exactly when Re s = 1/2, as a Lean theorem of chapter 36 states.
summary_zh: 独自用 x ↦ cos x 省察自己的观察者，每一步都越过 θ* ≈ 0.739；互相丈量的两位观察者逐轮只从一侧逼近 θ*。从 θ* 出发，外部角度尺上等步走，第二步就撞上 90°；在快度 η = ∫ sec θ dθ 上等步走，则是一架阶梯，缝 1 − tanh η 永不闭合。复平面上，同一道边是单位圆：‖(s − 1)/s‖ = 1 当且仅当 Re s = 1/2，正如第三十六章的一条 Lean 定理所述。
